text:
Maria G: quick sync — we keep getting PR comments about inconsistent param casing across SDK snippets and CLI examples. PR #4390 flagged camelCase in JS snippets but snake_case in Python examples. Can we pick a canonical mapping?

Ajay P: yep. we need consistency across languages. proposal: JSON payloads and public REST/SDK fields -> camelCase; Python client kwargs -> snake_case aliases pointing to camelCase; CLI flags -> kebab-case. keeps idiomatic per ecosystem.

Samira L: that sounds pragmatic. If we do that, docs should show canonical JSON (camelCase) and then per-language example with idiomatic form. add a short table in style guide.

Kevin H: agree. consequence: update ~18 SDK snippets and 6 CLI examples. quick grep: ```git grep -n "voice_param\|generation_limit\|stop_tokens" docs/ examples/ sdk/ | wc -l``` -> 24 matches. will list exact files in a follow-up comment.

Lexi C: can we also add a docs-lint rule to flag mismatched casing in code blocks? would prevent regressions.

LintBot: NOTE: new rule request logged as DOCS-LINT-17. Attach: param-case-checker.

Maria G: excellent. action items: 1) Samira to add a small table and examples to docs/style/param-casing.md 2) Ajay to add alias guidance for Python SDK (snake -> camel) in SDK README 3) Lexi to run edits across open PRs and update snippets 4) Kevin to add the lint rule config to .docs-lintrc. timeline: aim for EOW.

Samira L: starting doc patch now. sample table I'll add: "JSON (canonical): generationLimit; Python keyword: generation_limit (alias); CLI flag: --generation-limit". Also will note how to document reserved words and acronyms.

Ajay P: will draft the SDK README snippet showing how kwargs map, e.g.: ```python
# canonical JSON
payload = {"generationLimit": 256}
# python helper
client.generate(generation_limit=256)  # maps to generationLimit
```

Lexi C: I'll update the PRs and run integration examples. tagging folks on the PRs I touch. small gotcha: some example tests assert exact strings; I'll open small test-fix PRs where needed.

Kevin H: adding lint rule: param-case-checker will scan fenced code blocks for JSON vs language-specific patterns. I'll prototype and push a rule to docs-ci branch.

Maria G: one more thing — for glossary and search we should include aliases so users searching snake_case still find camelCase entries. Samira, add aliases in glossary entries you touch.

Samira L: will do. also adding a note about localization: translators get the canonical JSON keys and localize only prose, not keys.

Ajay P: can we put a short migration note in the release notes? even if it's editorial, useful for platform integrators.

Maria G: yes — I'll add a one-line bullet: "Docs: clarified canonical param casing (JSON: camelCase) and added per-language examples and linter checks."

Lexi C: grep output (files to edit): ```docs/api/reference.md: lines 120-132
examples/python/generate_snippet.py: lines 8-22
sdk/js/usage.md: lines 40-55
examples/cli/README.md: lines 10-18
tests/examples/test_snippets.py: lines 2-10
``` will open PRs and assign reviewers.

Kevin H: CI note: lint rule will be opt-in for one week, then enforced. I'll add a bot message when it flips.

Maria G: perfect. thanks all — label this thread ACTION and leave it open until PRs land. :sparkles:
